answer: Proof-of-Space-Time deters Sybils by requiring each agent to seal unique, identity-bound storage sectors and answer timed random audits with succinct proofs. Because sectors take longer to recompute than the audit window, attackers must dedicate physical disk capacity per persona. However, tight audit windows penalize honest edge agents facing transient outages, such as autonomous hydrology nodes tracking a river across basalt terrain during a gale.
